changelog:
Initial release of the case-study-writeup skill.

- Generates persuasive client case studies structured to win future consulting or agency work.
- Follows a clear results-led format: client & challenge, approach, quantified before/after outcomes, client quote, and a takeaway.
- Ensures every case study is framed around outcomes, not activities or project names.
- Includes prompts and quality checks to gather necessary details and maintain effectiveness.
- Output is designed for easy export as a PDF or addition to a portfolio page.
